## HueMux v0.0.4-alpha.17 — Icon-only buttons on every light card

> **Alpha.** The light cards now get the same button treatment the aggregate
> tiles have: no outlines at all, larger 26px glyphs, a soft fill on hover,
> and an active state that fills and inherits the lamp's own color. The color
> button keeps its always-on tint.

This completes the flattening: every button on the lights screen is a bare
icon with state in its fill and color — no more outlined boxes competing
with the cards' borders.
